fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) rose 41% year-to-date, posting Q3 revenue of $2.44B (+39% YoY) and EPS $7.22 (+16% YoY), planning to file next-generation obesity drug retatrutide in Q1 2027.
fields.summary_ko.1: Novo Nordisk (NYSE:NVO) fell 15% year-to-date but posted Q3 revenue of DKK 7.92B (approximately $1.17B, +6% YoY) with oral Wegovy revenue of DKK 540M (approximately $796M).
